news.headline: Cognex (NASDAQ:CGNX) reports Q3 2026 in line with expectations but stock drops
news.summary: Machine vision technology company Cognex (NASDAQ:CGNX) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 13.2% year on year to $313.4 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $280 million, coming in 2.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.53 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
